# Artemis Leonardou

> Full stack engineer and tech content creator based in Athens. Building products and teaching people to build with AI.

Artemis Leonardou (known online as Artemis Codes, @artemisvibecodes) is a 19-year-old engineer and content creator. She is a Founding Engineer at KanoParty, an Informatics student at NKUA (Top 1%), and a tech content creator with 35k+ monthly views across TikTok and Instagram.

## What she does

- **Builds**: Full stack web applications, AI-integrated products, mobile apps (Python/Django, Next.js, React Native)
- **Creates**: Short-form tech content on TikTok and Instagram (@artemisvibecodes) covering AI tools, vibe coding, and practical AI builder tutorials
- **Teaches**: Prompting techniques, AI-assisted development workflows, rapid prototyping with AI builders

## Creator profile

- Platforms: TikTok and Instagram as @artemisvibecodes, YouTube as @artemiscodes
- Audience: Tier-1 (US, EU, AU, CA) tech and builder audience
- Monthly reach: 35k+ views
- Content style: fast-paced, educational, practical — shows real builds with real prompts
- Active UGC partner: Lovable (AI app builder)
- Past brand experience: NOFire AI, Intel (Student Ambassador)

## Developer profile

- Current role: AI Product Developer / Founding Engineer at KanoParty (Jul 2025 - present)
- Education: Informatics, NKUA (National & Kapodistrian University of Athens), Top 1%
- Credentials: 10+ hackathons, several first-place finishes
- Stack: Python, Django, Next.js, React Native, PostgreSQL, Tailwind, Supabase

## Available for

- UGC campaigns for AI tools, developer tools, SaaS products, and tech products
